newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ's low interest rate policy appropriate -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: BOJ's low interest rate policy appropriate -- MOF.

text.p: The low interest rate policy of the Bank of Japan (BOJ) is seen as appropriate, as it is helping an economic recovery by reducing the burden of interest rate payments on individuals and companies, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Wednesday.
He told the finance committee of parliament's Upper House that he feels sorry about people dependent on interest rate payments, because interest rates are low.
"However, low interest rates are helping the economy greatly by reducing the burden on households and companies in paying interest," he said.

Mitsuzuka said: "Once the Bank of Japan is assured of the firmness of the economy, I think the governor of the bank and the board of directors may discuss measures to address the situation of those people dependent on interest rate payments."
